description: htmem — HTML as the canonical memory and communications format for Claude Code and other AI agents.

plugins.name: htmem
plugins.description: Teach Claude Code (and any MCP-aware agent) to use single-file HTML as persistent memory and inter-agent comms. Dual-pipeline rendering: sanitized LLM-read view + sandboxed human-render view. Schema-validated JSON data islands. Tamper-evident SHA-256 anchor. Zero runtime deps.
